scripts.build: npm run build -w @outrank/shared && npm run build -w @outrank/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @outrank/shared && npm run typecheck -w @outrank/api
scripts.smoke: npm run build && npm run smoke -w @outrank/api
scripts.render:build: npm run build -w @outrank/shared && npx prisma generate --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build -w @outrank/api
scripts.render:start: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate deploy && node scripts/import-questions.mjs && node dist/main.js
